title: MUSA: Multifractal Spectrum Analyzer
description: QGIS plugin and Python library for fractal and multifractal analysis of fault, fracture and lineament maps. It computes Renyi dimensions and Chhabra-Jensen spectra from the exact trace length in each grid cell, checks whether a finite-range scaling estimate is supported before reporting it, and offers a Monte Carlo test that relocates the observed traces within the mapped area.
